package player

import (
	casual "example.com/merge-casual-practice/game/mergecasual"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

const TimerChallenge int32 = 1

func (component *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(handlers *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	handlers.Register(TimerChallenge, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		d := component.owner.Dao()
		if d.GetWakeTimer() != f.ID {
			return 0
		}
		s, err := casual.Decode(d.GetState())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := s.Expire(uint64(f.Param1), f.Deadline.UnixMilli(), f.Now.UnixMilli()); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		d.SetState(s.Encode())
		d.SetWakeTimer(0)
		return 0
	})
}
